|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Hyperwave Scan (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 18 June 2023<ref name="ht-781a0de">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual21-Dark/large/hyperwavescan.gif</code> as published 18 June 2023: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/781a0de1bab57c271fca72a4887b826bb1a30838/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Dark/large/hyperwavescan.gif holotable commit 781a0de] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on a location. At same battleground, opponent may not cancel or reduce your Force drains here. You initiate battles here for free. If you just initiated battle here, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. Total battle destiny and forfeit values may not be increased here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 2, file created 17 June 2023: “Deploy on a location. At same battleground, opponent may not cancel or reduce your Force drains here. You initiate battles here for free. If you just initiated battle here, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. Total battle destiny and forfeit values may not be increased here.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Hyperwave Scan (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “Hyperwave Scan”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Hyperwave Scan (V)]] (published 18 June 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Hyperwave Scan]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
